headline: Open the pilot gate, not production authority.
position: The next useful move is not a live AI answer engine. It is a controlled source retrieval pilot where every output is draft, visible, and reviewable.
copy: VedaPath can now test retrieval behavior against curated records while keeping public answer authority, automatic storage, and live model execution disabled.

flow.title: Curate
flow.copy: Only reviewed source records enter the pilot lane.

flow.title: Retrieve
flow.copy: Candidates show source, match reason, and missing fields.

flow.title: Review
flow.copy: Reviewer decisions stay visible before answer drafting.

postures.title: Static curated pilot
postures.copy: Use local JSON records and visible source cards.

postures.title: Reviewer-assisted draft
postures.copy: Reviewer can mark accept, hold, return, or block.

postures.title: Live public answer authority
postures.copy: No production AI authority until source rights, review identity, and safety gates exist.

decisions.label: Retrieval
decisions.reason: Local source records, no live corpus.

decisions.label: Answer
decisions.reason: Every learner answer is visibly non-production.

decisions.label: Release
decisions.reason: Founder review before public pilot expansion.

locks.title: No hidden corpus
locks.copy: Every candidate must point to a visible source record.

locks.title: No silent acceptance
locks.copy: Corrections and reviewer notes become records, not invisible edits.

locks.title: No spiritual authority
locks.copy: The product explains source lanes and boundaries, not ritual or guru authority.

packet:
Production Retrieval Pilot Gate
Allowed: static curated retrieval, reviewer draft decisions, local QA.
Blocked: live public answer authority, production storage, automatic spiritual or therapeutic advice.
Founder decision: continue into verified source records before live retrieval.
